candidates.name: Read-only queue and descriptor-pool health diagnostics
candidates.purpose: After hardware/ABI validation,consider exposing aggregate queue occupancy,pool availability and allocation-failure counters to distinguish resource pressure from scheduling or delivery uncertainty.
evidence: 6A626 links descriptors through controller-record+280/+284 and calls the event setter
57862 scans16-byte nodes for requestedFF54 orFFFF;6A626 narrows the tag with a byte-read/halfword-write
Pool miss returns7 and may invoke staCB(1,0x5555);zero return ignores the event-setter result
Pool count depends on copied BufNumber and a separate mode byte;nominal8 gives9 or16 nodes only conditionally
constraints: No implementation,BLE commands or live telemetry in this milestone
Require validated memory/Flash budget,callback lifetime and read-only protocol before any instrumentation
Aggregate metadata only;never expose packet payloads,addresses,security records or identity values
Do not diagnose historical OTA letterE from candidate numeric statuses
Do not change queue sizes,automatically retry sends,or infer physical delivery from enqueue success
